title: Mediterranean Cities and Islands
description: The Mediterranean encompasses great diversity: cultural, religious, geographic, etc. Historically various regions of the sea have been linked through processes of mobility, channeled through port cities and island entrepots. This mobility centered on trade and religious pilgrimage, as well as the movement of people and goods associated with warfare, piracy, and captive-taking. What better place to explore Mediterranean connectivity than the cities that served as anchor points in this complex web?
